description: Hub FAB opens AddChatDialog so a chat can start by recipient ID without the lobby
steps: Open ChatListScreen
FAB with Add icon is visible on the dark hub
Tap FAB: AddChatDialog appears
Enter a recipient id, confirm, navigate to chat/{canonicalId}
Dismiss without submit: stay on hub, no new chat required
Lobby icon still opens lobby
./gradlew test

description: Lobby presence only while Lobby is open; heartbeat 30s; peer TTL 90s; QoS 0; intervals in Constants
steps: Hub and ChatScreen do not publish zerodata/public/lobby
Open Lobby: presence starts; leave Lobby: presence and subscribe stop
Heartbeat interval is 30s (not 5s); stale peers drop after 90s
Constants.kt holds the interval/TTL values
./gradlew test

description: Publish compact MQTT chat JSON with short keys; still decode the old Message JSON
steps: Outgoing publish is smaller than full Message model JSON (no unused enum noise required on the wire)
Incoming old-format Message JSON still inserts a Room message
Incoming compact JSON inserts a Room message
Domain/Room models unchanged for UI
Mapper unit tests for both formats
./gradlew test

description: Persist SENT after publish, ERROR on failure, retry SENDING/ERROR on MQTT reconnect
steps: Successful send ends as SENT in Room
Failed publish ends as ERROR
On reconnect, pending outgoing messages are published again
No DELIVERED or READ status usage
ChatRepositoryImplTest covers success, failure, retry
./gradlew test

description: Cellular MQTT options: keepAlive 60s, timeout 30s, stable clientId from userId, cleanSession false, auto-reconnect
steps: MqttConnectOptions set keepAliveInterval=60, connectionTimeout=30, automaticReconnect=true, cleanSession=false
clientId is stable for a userId (no random suffix per process)
App does not disconnect MQTT solely because it went to background in this item
./gradlew test

description: Foreground service remoteMessaging holds MQTT in background plus a one-time battery-optimization exemption request
steps: MQTT stays up when the activity is backgrounded (FGS with remoteMessaging)
Low-priority ongoing notification that the messenger is connected
Manifest service + existing FGS/POST_NOTIFICATIONS permissions wired
First launch can prompt ignore-battery-optimizations; no loop of dialogs
UI/ViewModels still do not call MqttManager for chat
./gradlew test

description: Single MQTT_SERVER_URI config (default public EMQX) with comment for a self-hosted ssl:// broker
steps: All MQTT connects read one constant or BuildConfig field, default tcp://broker.emqx.io:1883
Comment documents pointing to a private Mosquitto/EMQX (ssl://host:8883)
No settings screen in this item
App still builds and unit tests pass with the default URI
./gradlew test
